input.summary:
parts/fittings.mjs now has 0 refused and 0 off-palette writes (552 placed); make.sh writes build.nbt.
The gin's wagon-door leaves and hay-door leaves moved one cell in front of the wall (z 8), since the shell owns the wall plane there; the wagon lintel is dropped.
Other plots unchanged.
left: Gin lintel: the plan's stripped_spruce_log lintel at y5 x3..8 z9 is birch_planks from shell-a (parts/shell-a.mjs, locked, not editable here). Fix in shell-a by leaving y5 x3..8 as stripped_spruce_log, or accept the birch course.

Gin front leaves now sit at z8 x2..3 and x8..9 (y1..4) and x4 and x7 (y7..8). The plan's yard bales at x1..3 z6..8 (grounds part) will collide with the x2..3 leaves at z8 y1..2 when grounds is built. Grounds must move the bales or skip those cells.
Not this part: hearths part reports 'flight: nothing to step out onto at 86,6,9' (owner's upper floor). Owner's flight belongs to the hearths/stairs part.

Leaves are placed as open trapdoors facing north at z8 (the same convention as the shutters). I checked the refusal count and the palette report, not the visual result; a render check of the gin front is still needed.

waste.what: Worked out by hand which of the 26 refused cells came from the wagon-door lintel, the wagon leaves and the hay-door leaves, and by how much each one overlapped the shell.
waste.cost: about 6 coordinate checks plus one cross-read of shell-a.mjs and vocab/h2.mjs and h3.mjs
waste.tool: parts-report.json had the full refusedAt list, but make.sh printed only 8 samples. make.sh should print every refused cell, grouped by the helper call that wrote it (for example 'wagonDoor at 4,1,9: 22 cells: lintel 6, leaves 16').

waste.what: Moved the folded door leaves in front of the wall by hand, cell by cell, with a new local leaf() helper, because wagonDoor and hayDoor only write in the wall plane.
waste.tool: vocab wagonDoor/hayDoor should take a front offset (f) and an option to skip the lintel, for example { front: 1, lintel: false }. wallCell already supports f, but the option is not exposed.

companions.task: Check that the gin's folded board leaves read as doors when they stand one cell in front of the wall, and decide the wagon lintel: birch course from the shell, or a stripped log lintel that the shell has to leave open.
